March 3, 2026
Reignite Cyber Solutions Inc. 14 Domingo M. Guevara, Mandaluyong, 1550 Metro Manila
Dear Reignite Cyber Solutions:
As a requirement of the Computer Science program at National University, students must
undergo internship for 400 hours for one (1) term. The main objective of the internship
program is to expose students to actual scenarios and real-life applications of the principles
and concepts learned inside the classroom. In this regard, we would like to recommend Miguel Raphael Layos, a BS Computer Science
student, for internship with your company. Mr.

Layos has completed at least 70% of the
required academic units and is expected to graduate within the academic year. The
opportunity for Mr. Layos to work with you will allow him to apply what he has learned and
will expose him to the actual workplace environment. Attached is his resumé for your
reference. Should you have any questions, please feel free to get in touch with us through our landline,
+632 7121900 loc 1456, or through email, nuccit@national-u.edu.ph. We are looking forward to being your partner in producing graduates who can make positive
contributions to the industry. Thank you. Very truly yours,
Julie Anne A. Crystal
Internship Coordinator
ACO-CI-F-013
